note: TOWN LIGHT, baked by gen/bake/bake.cjs from gen/bake/townlight.ts (the old build's light maps). day: the static lights' pools over the ambient, multiplied into the ground (assets/townground) and then laid over it soft-light at `glow`; night: the night light over the day light, multiplied over the town at (1 - daylight). Both cover the town from world (0, 0) at k = 0.25 px per world unit (`bandLimit`), origin world (0, 0). lamps: each static lamp's and torch's hot core by night, [x, y, radius in world units, colour, strength].
